comment: Utility methods for parsing DTS frames.

variables.name: DTS_MAX_RATE_BYTES_PER_SECOND
variables.comment:
* Maximum rate for a DTS audio stream, in bytes per second. * *

DTS allows an 'open' bitrate, but we assume the maximum listed value: 1536 kbit/s.

variables.name: DTS_HD_MAX_RATE_BYTES_PER_SECOND
variables.comment: Maximum rate for a DTS-HD audio stream, in bytes per second.

variables.name: CHANNELS_BY_AMODE
variables.comment: Maps AMODE to the number of channels. See ETSI TS 102 114 table 5.4.

variables.name: SAMPLE_RATE_BY_SFREQ
variables.comment: Maps SFREQ to the sampling frequency in Hz. See ETSI TS 102 144 table 5.5.

variables.name: TWICE_BITRATE_KBPS_BY_RATE
variables.comment: Maps RATE to 2 * bitrate in kbit/s. See ETSI TS 102 144 table 5.7.

methods.name: public static boolean isSyncWord(int word)
methods.comment:
* Returns whether a given integer matches a DTS sync word. Synchronization and storage modes are
   * defined in ETSI TS 102 114 V1.1.1 (2002-08), Section 5.3.
   *
   * @param word An integer.
   * @return Whether a given integer matches a DTS sync word.

methods.name: public static Format parseDtsFormat(byte[] frame, @Nullable String trackId, @Nullable String language, @Nullable DrmInitData drmInitData)
methods.comment:
* Returns the DTS format given {@code data} containing the DTS frame according to ETSI TS 102 114
   * subsections 5.3/5.4.
   *
   * @param frame The DTS frame to parse.
   * @param trackId The track identifier to set on the format.
   * @param language The language to set on the format.
   * @param drmInitData {@link DrmInitData} to be included in the format.
   * @return The DTS format parsed from data in the header.

methods.name: public static int parseDtsAudioSampleCount(byte[] data)
methods.comment:
* Returns the number of audio samples represented by the given DTS frame.
   *
   * @param data The frame to parse.
   * @return The number of audio samples represented by the frame.

methods.name: public static int parseDtsAudioSampleCount(ByteBuffer buffer)
methods.comment:
* Like {@link #parseDtsAudioSampleCount(byte[])} but reads from a {@link ByteBuffer}. The
   * buffer's position is not modified.
   *
   * @param buffer The {@link ByteBuffer} from which to read.
   * @return The number of audio samples represented by the syncframe.

methods.name: public static int getDtsFrameSize(byte[] data)
methods.comment:
* Returns the size in bytes of the given DTS frame.
   *
   * @param data The frame to parse.
   * @return The frame's size in bytes.

methodNames: public static Format parseDtsFormat(byte[] frame, @Nullable String trackId, @Nullable String language, @Nullable DrmInitData drmInitData)
